Trigger.name: skill-loop maneuver slot free
Trigger.script:
-- "You decide to try a combat maneuver!" means the skill slot is open. -- Fire the next iteration of the loop immediately. if not skill_loop or not skill_loop.active then return end
if not icesus or not icesus.state or not icesus.state.inCombat then skill_loop.active = false skill_loop.paused = false skill_loop_cancel_watch() cecho("\n<orange>[LOOP]<reset> Loop stopped — left combat.\n") return end
if skill_loop.sacrifice then skill_loop_check_hp() else send(skill_loop.cmd, false) end

Trigger.name: skill-loop battle over
Trigger.script: -- Combat ended — stop the loop and cancel any queued skill usage. if skill_loop and skill_loop.active then skill_loop.active = false skill_loop.paused = false skill_loop_cancel_watch() cecho("\n<orange>[LOOP]<reset> Loop stopped — Battle Over.\n") end send("stop", false)

Trigger.name: skill-loop auto-start on new attack
Trigger.script:
-- "You attack X and get a chance to try to hit first!" fires when you -- engage a new foe. Auto-start the loop with the last skill used, -- but only if a skill has been set and the loop isn't already running. if not skill_loop or not skill_loop.last_cmd or skill_loop.last_cmd == "" then return end if skill_loop.active then return end
skill_loop.active = true skill_loop.paused = false skill_loop.sacrifice = false skill_loop.cmd = skill_loop.last_cmd
skill_loop_cancel_watch() cecho("\n<cyan>[LOOP]<reset> Auto-starting: <white>" .. skill_loop.cmd .. "<reset>\n") send(skill_loop.cmd, false)

regexCodeList.string: ^You attack .+ and get a chan(?:ce|ge) to try to hit first!

Alias.name: bj
Alias.script: local target = (matches[2] and matches[2] ~= "") and (" at " .. matches[2]) or "" local cmd = "use blow of justice" .. target skill_loop_start(cmd, false)

Alias.name: bjs — blow of justice sacrifice
Alias.script:
local arg1 = (matches[2] and matches[2] ~= "") and matches[2] or nil local arg2 = (matches[3] and matches[3] ~= "") and matches[3] or nil
local target, hppct if arg1 then if tonumber(arg1) then hppct = arg1 else target = arg1 if arg2 and tonumber(arg2) then hppct = arg2 end end end
local cmd = "use blow of justice at" if target then cmd = cmd .. " " .. target end cmd = cmd .. " to sacrifice" if hppct then cmd = cmd .. " " .. hppct .. "% of health" end
skill_loop_start(cmd, true)

Alias.name: loop
Alias.script:
-- Start looping whatever skill was last used, without changing which skill -- is remembered. Optionally override the target: "loop orc" re-targets -- the last skill at a new target if the command contains a target slot. local override_target = (matches[2] and matches[2] ~= "") and matches[2] or nil
if not skill_loop or not skill_loop.last_cmd or skill_loop.last_cmd == "" then cecho("\n<red>[LOOP]<reset> No skill set yet — use bj / kick / sr / sp first.\n") return end
local cmd = skill_loop.last_cmd if override_target then -- Replace the existing target in common patterns, or just append " at <target>" -- Strip old " at <word>" suffix and re-append with new target cmd = cmd:gsub("%s+at%s+%S+$", "") cmd = cmd .. " at " .. override_target end
skill_loop_start(cmd, false)

Alias.name: loopstop
Alias.script:
if skill_loop and skill_loop.active then skill_loop.active = false skill_loop.paused = false skill_loop_cancel_watch() cecho("
<orange>[LOOP]<reset> Loop stopped.
") else cecho("
<grey>[LOOP]<reset> No loop running.
") end

Script.name: skill-loop functions
Script.script:
SKILL_LOOP_HP_FLOOR = 0.30 SKILL_LOOP_WATCH_INTERVAL = 1.0
skill_loop = skill_loop or {} -- skill_loop.last_cmd persists across combats; set by skill_loop_start() -- skill_loop.cmd is the command currently being looped -- skill_loop.active / .paused / .sacrifice as before
function skill_loop_cancel_watch() if skill_loop.watch_timer then killTimer(skill_loop.watch_timer) skill_loop.watch_timer = nil end end
function skill_loop_hp_ratio() if not icesus or not icesus.state then return 1.0 end local v = icesus.state.vitals if not v or not v.hpmax or v.hpmax == 0 then return 1.0 end return v.hp / v.hpmax end
function skill_loop_check_hp() if not skill_loop or not skill_loop.active then return end
local ratio = skill_loop_hp_ratio()
if ratio >= SKILL_LOOP_HP_FLOOR then if skill_loop.paused then skill_loop.paused = false skill_loop_cancel_watch() cecho("\n<green>[LOOP]<reset> HP recovered (" .. math.floor(ratio * 100) .. "%) — resuming sacrifice loop.\n") end send(skill_loop.cmd, false) else if not skill_loop.paused then skill_loop.paused = true cecho("\n<red>[LOOP]<reset> HP at " .. math.floor(ratio * 100) .. "% — sacrifice paused until above " .. math.floor(SKILL_LOOP_HP_FLOOR * 100) .. "%.\n") end
if not skill_loop.watch_timer then skill_loop.watch_timer = tempTimer(SKILL_LOOP_WATCH_INTERVAL, function() skill_loop.watch_timer = nil if not skill_loop or not skill_loop.active then return end if not icesus or not icesus.state or not icesus.state.inCombat then skill_loop.active = false skill_loop.paused = false cecho("\n<orange>[LOOP]<reset> Loop stopped — left combat while paused.\n") return end skill_loop_check_hp() end, false) end end end
-- Central entry point used by every skill alias. -- cmd : full command string to send (e.g. "kick orc") -- sacrifice: boolean — use the HP-gated sacrifice path function skill_loop_start(cmd, sacrifice) skill_loop = skill_loop or {} skill_loop.active = true skill_loop.paused = false skill_loop.sacrifice = sacrifice or false skill_loop.cmd = cmd skill_loop.last_cmd = cmd -- remember for auto-start and "loop" alias
skill_loop_cancel_watch() cecho("\n<cyan>[LOOP]<reset> Looping: <white>" .. cmd .. "<reset>\n")
if sacrifice then skill_loop_check_hp() else send(cmd, false) end end

Script.name: skill-loop gmcp combat handler
Script.script:
-- Stop the loop whenever GMCP reports we've left combat. function skill_loop_on_status() if not skill_loop or not skill_loop.active then return end if not icesus or not icesus.state or not icesus.state.inCombat then skill_loop.active = false skill_loop.paused = false skill_loop_cancel_watch() cecho("\n<orange>[LOOP]<reset> Loop stopped — left combat.\n") end end
if skill_loop_status_handler then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, skill_loop_status_handler) end skill_loop_status_handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler( "gmcp.Char.Status", "skill_loop_on_status")
